note: Generic outreach templates. Copy to profile/outreach-templates.json and replace the bracketed parts with your own facts. The tracker fills {{company}}, {{role}} and {{url}}; {{name}} stays for you to fill.

templates.label: Referral request (connection note)
templates.text: Hi {{name}}, I'm a [one-line who you are] applying for the {{role}} role at {{company}}. Would you be open to a quick chat or a referral? Happy to send a short blurb.

templates.label: Referral request (DM after they accept)
templates.text:
Hi {{name}}, thanks for connecting.

I'm applying for the {{role}} role at {{company}}: {{url}}

Why I fit: [one result with a number]. [Second line of fit].

If you're comfortable referring me, here's a blurb you can forward:
"[Your name], [who you are], applying for {{role}}. [Best proof point]. Resume attached."

No worries if not, and thanks either way.

[Your name]

templates.label: Cold DM to hiring manager / founder
templates.text:
Hi {{name}}, I applied for the {{role}} role at {{company}} and wanted to reach out directly.

[One specific thing about {{company}} you checked is true].

[One result with a number, plus a link to your work].

Would a 15-minute call work this week?

[Your name]

templates.label: Cold email
templates.subject: {{role}} at {{company}} - [Your name]
templates.text:
Hi {{name}},

I'm [one-line who you are], and I'd love to be considered for the {{role}} role at {{company}} ({{url}}).

[One result with a number]. [Second line of fit].

Resume attached. Could we find 15 minutes to talk, or is there someone better to speak to?

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Phone] · [LinkedIn]

templates.label: Follow-up (5-7 days later)
templates.text: Hi {{name}}, following up on my note about the {{role}} role at {{company}}. Still very interested. If someone else handles hiring for it, a name would help a lot. Thanks!
